subtitle: Word hunt, fully offline
promotional_text: An on-device word hunt. Trace letters across the wooden grid and keep a private field book.
description: Fernquest is a complete offline word hunt. Finish onboarding, follow Walk through four moves, run Four Columns, choose a Range for the trail clock, and save a Tablet note. On the home grid, tap letters from left to right to find PATH, FIND, LORE, and QUEST. There is no account, no login, no cloud sync, and no remote AI. Your clock and field book stay on the device.
app_review_notes: Fernquest is a fully offline word-hunt game and private field book. Review flow: complete onboarding, open Walk and advance the four moves, start Four Columns, choose a Range, then save a Tablet note. On Home, tap P-A-T-H to mark PATH found. No sign-in, network calls, camera, or photo library access.
